items.t: Crazy weather we're having, huh?
items.z: 这天气真够离谱的，是吧？

items.t: It's supposed to rain all weekend.
items.z: 据说整个周末都要下雨。

items.t: Stay warm out there.
It's a scorcher today.
Any plans for the weekend?
How's work treating you?
Did you catch the game last night?
I can't believe it's already September.
items.z: 真不敢相信已经九月了。

items.t: Is it just me, or is this line not moving?
items.z: 是我错觉吗，这队根本没动？

items.t: Long day?
Have a good one!
Hey, how's it going? Good, you?
items.z: 嘿，最近怎么样？挺好的，你呢？

items.t: I've been meaning to try that new place.
items.z: 我一直想去试试那家新店。

items.t: The traffic this morning was brutal.
I could really use a coffee right now.
items.z: 我现在真需要来杯咖啡。

items.t: Hope your week's going well.
Living the dream.
Same old, same old.
Nice to see a friendly face.
Well, I'll let you get back to it.
